edits.before: Full kit: crash the carry, Q the shields off, and steal the resistances your trades need.

edits.before: First item: the crash chains and the stolen stats compound.
edits.after: Un-blockable hard CC beats his reactive single-target peel.

edits.before: Late Rell makes clumps: R the formation, crash the center, and let the team bill the gravity.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Wait for his E to face away, or for it to drop, then charge — a raised shield eats the knockup's follow-up.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.

edits.before: - Braum Unbreakable: matchup-defining — The shield wall eats your poke and engage projectiles — wait it out. It writes your spacing rules. - E Full Tilt (remount speed) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Braum E Unbreakable: 16s at rank 1 down to 8s at 5 — wait for it to drop or catch him mid-cooldown before you charge. - Q Winter's Bite: 8s to 6s, his poke window. - R Glacial Fissure (130/115/100s) — bait it before you commit your own R.
